body.statement:
Under the declared Job Corps assignment, support, randomization, consistency, no-defiers, complier-conditional selection-monotonicity, and \(M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\ge m_*>0\) restrictions, let \(P_0\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\), set \(p_0=p(P_0)\), and impose the declared relative-interior and tangent-image conditions. The response-type fiber computes the separate same-law endpoints and proves
\[
 \Theta_{\mathrm{ASC}}(p_0)
 \subseteq\prod_{t\in\mathcal T}
 [\underline\Delta(t;p_0),\overline\Delta(t;p_0)],
\]
with no rectangle-equality claim. The completed tangent cells define a lawful \(\mathfrak G_0\in\mathfrak E\) with certified nonempty \(H_{r_0}\). Under the sampled-data assumptions, Carter's theorem and the explicit moving-face ledger give fixed-compact and compatible moving-offset semantic transfer. Under zero-offset centering, the expanding-window values satisfy
\[
 M_n^{\diamond}\to M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0),
 \qquad
 \liminf_nM_n\ge M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0).
\]
Conditional on effective compatible density, CertGluePFL returns an \(\varepsilon\)-accurate replayable Gaussian certificate and the windowed transferred rules are replayable. No globally honest unbounded sampled-data primal, global \(\limsup_nM_n\), or two-sided global multinomial minimax limit is asserted.
body.justification: The proposition retains exact same-law causal identification, lawful tangent geometry, compact transfer, and conditional replayable Gaussian certification.
body.gap: A global unbounded sampled-data primal and global two-sided minimax convergence are no longer promised.
body.consumer: The workflow supports simultaneous ordered-wage assertions with an expanding-window sampled-data receipt and no rectangle-equality overclaim.
body.proof_tex:
The observed cell contrasts, exact response-type fiber, and separate endpoint witnesses are established by \(\text{thm:causal-label-polyhedralization}\), \(\text{prop:lower-endpoint-attainment}\), and \(\text{prop:upper-endpoint-attainment}\). Therefore each coordinate endpoint is attained by one compatible law, while every same-law vector belongs coordinatewise to the displayed interval; this proves the outer inclusion and does not assert joint attainability of its corners. The compatible-polytope and relative-interior lift in \(\text{prop:tangent-fan-global-cover}\), together with \(\text{prop:job-corps-radius-nonempty}\), prove that the completed cells cover \(\mathbb R^d\), that the covariance is positive definite, and that \(H_{r_0}\ne\varnothing\). Thus \(\mathfrak G_0\in\mathfrak E\).

On every fixed compact, \(\text{thm:fixed-stratum-transfer}\) applies Carter only to the positive-cell statistical experiment and separately charges the moving affine labels and covariance. For \(c_n\to c\in\mathcal K_0\), \(\text{thm:moving-offset-transfer}\) adds the rational offset error inside the displayed boundary band and remains compact-only. Under \(c_n\to0\), the corrected \(\text{thm:compact-exhaustion-transfer}\) gives both the windowed equality and the global lower limit. Conditional on effective compatible density, \(\text{thm:certglue-termination}\) supplies the replayable Gaussian primal--dual certificate, and the same transfer proofs make its windowed sample rules replayable. The escaping-boundary witness in \(\text{lem:escaping-boundary-kill}\) shows why these conclusions cannot be promoted to a global upper limit under compact-uniform premises. This establishes every assertion in the narrowed proposition.
